speaker: alse_pinder
text: You are on the stair, and she is not. The fire is new. If you sit, sit where the bench is warm, and do not start on the loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I looked at the apples and came down. I am not starting on anything until she has said which side of it I am allowed.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The soft side. She said it to me last night, so she would not have to say it twice to a man with a jaw. I am telling you so you can look as if you have just heard it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I have not heard it. Set the board. I will wait for her mouth, not yours.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is already on the third tread. He went up when you came down, which is his notion of a fair exchange. Step wide when you go back for the cloak.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will step wide. I am not arguing with a cat before the house is even at the table.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Nine is still nine. She will not have you prove anything at breakfast. If you are wanted up the road, the road can have you with a mouth that has only eaten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The road can have me at nine. This room can have me until she calls. I have rolls to look at, and I am not going to describe them to a loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I can hear the pair of you being early. I am putting a comb through my hair. Nobody is to be clever until I am on the stair.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There. You have your order. Sit, and look hungry, and leave the end of the loaf where I left it.
